evidence_items.observed_summary: The persisted local final receipt records 56 passing tests, including fourteen method-evidence and sixteen paper-quality skill-contract tests, package verification, and official validation while leaving remote lifecycle gates pending.
The skill defines the default paper-quality gate, active artifact inventory, recursive repair loop, fail-closed PENDING disposition, and convergence boundary.
